wholeClaimProof.summary: Whole candidate requires read-aloud, audio/video and quantitative/visual source summaries. Read-aloud alone cannot establish full candidate.
wholeClaimProof.prerequisite: Complete hard path mt_A4YUbzUFan -> mt_-DuXzMVVXQ; paraphrase needs accurate own-word restatement from passage and media, with copying contrast. No script inventory, print direction, reading, writing or English grammar gate remains.
wholeClaimProof.publicGuides: Neither candidate has a public teaching-research record at accepted base; no hidden guide obligations omitted.
wholeClaimProof.subjectBoundary: English subject placement is not evidence of universally English-only procedural semantics; every actual lexical/syntactic realization remains role-bound and must be checked by a competent assessor.

beforeUse: Record actual R1 identity and variety and competent source-language assessor; no fixed Hindi/English prescription.
Render each original semantic brief naturally in actual R1; assessor records exact spoken source and expected propositions. Translation is adapted semantic material, not an English syntax exercise.
Select accessible vocabulary and source length appropriate to preparatory stage and actual learner; do not cue the main ideas beforehand.
Record actual rendition, prompts, response, permitted supports, main-idea decisions and source/task versus full-candidate result separately.
bindingContract.failureCondition: No actual rendition or qualified meaning check means no actual learner success, no unconditional role-language coverage certification.

originalCasebank.delivery: Read aloud actual-R1 rendition; no text shown.
originalCasebank.semanticBrief: A class wants to reduce wasted water. A dripping tap is reported and repaired. Learners close taps after use. A blue bucket is mentioned only as a minor setting detail.
essentialPropositions: The class is reducing water waste.
Repairing a leak and closing taps are the useful actions.
originalCasebank.nearMiss: Blue bucket or repair-only answer without central purpose; copied final line; assessor names useful actions first.
originalCasebank.reasonProbe: Which detail could be left out without changing the main message, and why?

originalCasebank.semanticBrief: A group plans outdoor reading. Rain starts before the books are brought outside. They move under cover and keep the books dry; later the planned reading continues. A striped bag is incidental.
essentialPropositions: Moving under cover lets reading continue while protecting books.
originalCasebank.nearMiss: States that books got wet, confuses event order, or retells only bag appearance.
originalCasebank.transfer: New structure and minor detail; no reuse of water-waste answer.

originalCasebank.delivery: Actual recorded or live audio in actual R1, not merely an imagined recording.
originalCasebank.semanticBrief: A school announcement says a book exchange has moved from the yard to the library because of rain, retains the same start time, and asks participants to bring one book.
essentialPropositions: Exchange location changes because of rain.
originalCasebank.paraphraseCheck: Restate a selected segment accurately in own words; compare a copied segment with own-word meaning-preserving version.

originalCasebank.delivery: Show three labelled bars or accessible equivalent: Monday 4 borrowed books, Tuesday 7, Wednesday 5; actual R1 labels and oral prompt. No written-answer requirement.
essentialPropositions: Tuesday has the most, Monday the fewest.
Numbers rise then fall; Wednesday remains above Monday.
originalCasebank.nearMiss: Calls Wednesday highest, mistakes height for time, or reads isolated numbers without any summary.
originalCasebank.limits: This completes an existing candidate extension, not a new NCERT demand that every heard-summary source task include graphs.

decisionRules.sourceTask: Accurate selected central ideas in read-aloud and changed structure, with no invented contradiction; can justify an omitted incidental detail. Own wording, not exact translation or English syntax, is evaluated.
decisionRules.wholeCandidate: Read-aloud + changed passage + actual audio/media + quantitative display, including paraphrase hard-prerequisite evidence. Record source-only success separately if extensions absent.
decisionRules.coverage: Original authoring casebank is not an observed intervention or proof all R1 language realizations are already supplied.

status: Reviewed component proposal; Partial, not whole-expectation or learner mastery
ageRationale: Retain the accepted summary10–11 developmental guidance and prerequisite9–12 readiness overlap; no new age8–9 readiness or IN prerequisite association is inferred.
remainingConditions: Bind actual R1 material and a competent language/variety assessor before use; no fixed national language pair or cross-language transfer is inferred.

Source-only read-aloud success does not establish the complete media/quantitative summary claim or its oral-paraphrase prerequisite.

historicalConditionalContributions.condition: Withheld pending complete source-role/task and remaining claim/dependency compatibility review; the registered historical glossary/note-taking gate has been corrected.
